design.quote: This study evaluated the associations between baseline GDF-15 and the clinical characteristics and outcomes in patients with HF with reduced ejection fraction in the DAPA-HF (Dapagliflozin and Prevention of Adverse-outcomes in Heart Failure) trial.

population.value: Patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction (LVEF ≤ 40%)
population.quote: DAPA-HF was a randomized trial of dapagliflozin in patients with HF and LVEF ≤ 40%.

intervention.quote: The effect of the sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor dapagliflozin on circulating GDF-15 levels

comparator.quote: Dapagliflozin did not significantly change GDF-15 concentrations over 12 months, compared to placebo

follow_up.quote: GDF-15 was measured at baseline and 12 months.

primary_findings.quote: There was a stepwise increase in adjusted risk for the primary outcome across quartiles of baseline GDF-15 (adjusted hazard ratio [Q4 vs Q1] 2.30, 95% CI 1.66-18; P trend < 0.001).
primary_findings.outcome: Primary outcome (worsening HF or cardiovascular death) by baseline GDF-15 quartile (Q4 vs Q1)

primary_findings.quote: Dapagliflozin did not significantly change GDF-15 concentrations over 12 months, compared to placebo (placebo-corrected relative change +4%; 95% CI, -2% to +10%).
primary_findings.outcome: Change in GDF-15 concentrations over 12 months
